Data you can trace.

What the numbers and photos represent.

Specifications & missing data

Each part links to its source. Charts use a shared unit and start at zero. A dash means unavailable, not zero. Product names, years, and specifications come from the existing catalog; source availability can change.

Benchmarks & game performance

Specifications do not measure game FPS. PassMark G3D values, where available, are an inherited September 12, 2026 snapshot from PassMark. They aggregate different systems. This catalog has no matched game FPS dataset.

PC compatibility checks

The builder checks indexed sockets, memory, storage ports, slots, and power. Its estimate adds CPU TDP, GPU board power, and 100 W, then adds a 25% margin. Verify BIOS, dimensions, cooling, and exact connectors separately. Hardware outlooks are estimates, not benchmarks.

Product & reference photos

Official product photos come from the manufacturer and show the selected model. Other product photos show a verified model or partner card. Family photos show a related capacity or variant. Reference photos illustrate a related component and identify the actual model pictured; they do not verify the selected part’s appearance. Sources are available on each part page and below comparisons.
